content.text: In Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and many other countries, Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional payment processors won't let digital creators sell their digital products. This is not because they're not successful or trustworthy, but because these platforms impose their own geographic restrictions. As a result, many creators are forced to find alternative and often cumbersome ways to process payments. But what if you could own your own commerce infrastructure and avoid these limitations entirely?
What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH offers three comprehensive sovereign commerce stacks: the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation and source code for all 5 stacks. These solutions empower digital creators to build, deploy, and manage their own e-commerce infrastructure, free from the constraints of conventional payment processors. With COREMERCH, you get everything you need to create a seamless online store experience, including automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Unlike traditional payment processors, COREMERCH's sovereign stacks are designed to operate independently of geographic restrictions. This means that creators in restricted countries can sell their digital products without worrying about account freezes or payment platform suspensions. With COREMERCH, you have complete control over your commerce infrastructure, and you can deploy it anywhere in the world, without relying on third-party providers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

COREMERCH's sovereign stacks use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which comes with a 0.5% fee only. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10. In contrast, traditional payment processors often charge higher fees and may impose additional charges for international transactions. With COREMERCH, you get fast and secure payment processing, without the hidden costs.
Digital creators can break free from the constraints of conventional payment processors.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership structure of a COREMERCH deployment is explicit and verifiable. After any deployment, the customer holds all of the following under their own accounts: the storefront code in their GitHub or Cloudflare account, the customer email list in their Supabase database or Google Sheet, the order and payment history exportable as CSV at any time, the product files in their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, the NOWPayments account set up under their email address, all wallet addresses and the funds inside them, the domain and DNS configuration if a custom domain was used, and all analytics data in their own analytics account. COREMERCH has zero access to any of these after delivery. This is not a policy statement — it is the technical reality of how the deployment is structured. The store runs under your accounts from day one.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of sovereign commerce stack depends on your business needs and goals. The Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal for creators who want to get started quickly, while the Edge Commerce Stack is better suited for those who require more advanced features and automation. The Sovereign Blueprint is perfect for developers who want to customize their own commerce infrastructure. Regardless of which option you choose, COREMERCH provides everything you need to build a successful and sustainable digital business.

What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators? It means having complete control over your own commerce infrastructure, free from the constraints of conventional payment processors, and able to operate independently of geographic restrictions. With COREMERCH, you can build, deploy, and manage your own e-commerce infrastructure, and scale your business without worrying about account freezes or payment platform suspensions.
COREMERCH's sovereign stacks offer complete control over your commerce infrastructure and data.
